name: scripture-tools
description: Functions for working with scripture OSIS Identifiers and citations

scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:dts && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:gzip-size
scripts.build:clean: rm -Rf dist/ && mkdir dist && touch dist/.gitkeep
scripts.build:dts: yes | bunx dts-bundle-generator --project tsconfig.bundle-generator.json -o dist/index.d.ts ./index.ts && sed -i '' 's/WorkShape | null/WorkShape/g' dist/index.d.ts
scripts.build:gzip-size: echo 'gzipped savings and size:' && gzip -cv dist/index.mjs | wc -c
